angle: Label freezer bags before you fill them
hooks: Writing on a full freezer bag never works.

scenes.visual: Close-up that shows: Label the bag first
scenes.prompt: Vertical close-up, soft daylight, no people: label the bag first
scenes.voiceover: Writing on a full freezer bag never works.

scenes.prompt: Vertical shot, hands only, no faces: flat bag, clear writing
scenes.voiceover: Write on the bag while it is flat and dry. The pen actually works.

claims.text: A flat, dry bag is easier to write on than a full one.

scenes.prompt: Still life, top view, no text: name plus date
scenes.voiceover: Put the name and the date. Next month you will know what to eat first.

claims.text: A label with the contents and the date makes the oldest food easy to find.

scenes.visual: Wide shot of a tidy shelf
scenes.prompt: Vertical wide shot of a tidy shelf, slow push-in, no people
scenes.voiceover: What is the oldest thing in your freezer?
